Chapter 689: Chapter 2 Chikun Star Lord: Ninth Rank, This Is Ninth Rank! (Please Subscribe)

“My physical body and soul have both skyrocketed by a thousandfold…”

Lin Yuan was carefully savoring the sense of control brought about by his powerful physical form and soul.

At this moment, he was like a colossal celestial body. If he released his suppression,

all matter within several light-years would turn to dust and then orbit around him.

“With my current state, even if I only used the strength of my physical body, a single punch would be enough to shatter layers upon layers of space.”

Lin Yuan thought quietly to himself.

...

The thousandfold amplification of Lin Yuan’s physical body and soul wasn’t based on an ordinary Ninth Stage Peak.

It was based on a terrifying physical body that had been strengthened by the Mysterious Gourd, with a fundamental increase of over twenty times.

Moreover, the world force derived from his vast inner world was constantly nurturing Lin Yuan’s physical body and soul at every moment.

Add to that, the Martial Tao Cultivation System was inherently skilled at tempering the physical body.

That is to say, even before breaking through to the Tenth Rank, Lin Yuan’s physical strength was already hundreds to thousands of times that of a peer at the same Ninth Rank.

“No wonder, I’ve only heard of Eighth Layer invincibles surviving against Ninth Rank powerhouses, but never of a Ninth Rank managing to survive against a Tenth Rank…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

The increase was far too great.

Even if other Tenth Rank powerhouses only sustained infusion from the universe’s Origin Source,

they were far superior to any life on the Ninth Rank. Even special Ninth Rank beings had no power to fight back in front of a powerhouse who had just entered the Tenth Rank.

“The higher you go, the wider the gap between realms becomes. It’s like this from the Ninth to the Tenth Rank, from the Tenth to the Eleventh Rank, and so is the gap between the Eleventh Rank and the ultimate existences.”

Lin Yuan thought silently.

Especially from the Eleventh Rank to the ultimate, it was a chasm of whether or not one had broken free from the shackles of the River of Time.

Despite there being extremely powerful and ancient Eleventh-Rank lives in the Cosmic Starry Skies, which possess the confidence that makes ultimate beings hesitant to take action against them,

such as the ‘Mother of the Tree Realm.’

However, this hesitation doesn’t mean that these ancient and powerful Eleventh-Rank lives can withstand the methods of ultimate beings, but rather they can obliterate themselves before an ultimate being comes close to completely destroying them.

Leaving the ultimate existences to return empty-handed.

“Inner World…”

Lin Yuan dispatched a thread of his consciousness to descend into his inner world as an incarnation.

After sustaining the infinite Chaos Void Origin, Lin Yuan’s inner world showed no drastic changes in terms of size at first glance.

But within the world itself, a significant transformation had occurred in all aspects.

To put it simply,

it was much like the difference between the Central Divine Continent and the Spirit Realm.

Space became more stable, and the rules more balanced.

A strike of the same might created gulches spanning thousands of miles in the inner world at the Ninth Rank, but in the present inner world, perhaps it could only split a boulder?

“I can feel that, after receiving the Chaos Void Origin’s infusion, my inner world has made a connection with the Chaos Void, thereby improving moment by moment…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even without Lin Yuan taking any action,

the layers of spatial realms within his inner world were being slowly developed.

Lin Yuan’s inner world was entirely independent and could slowly absorb the power of the Chaos Void.

Other Tenth Rank Evolvers were a bit inferior, able to absorb only the power of the Main Universe, but probably not much different from Lin Yuan’s current state.

The spatial layers were unfolding slowly of their own accord, it was just much slower in terms of speed.

This is also why Tenth Rank powerhouses didn’t care about how many spatial layers their inner worlds had.

Because at the Tenth Rank level, the inner worlds would actively ‘synchronize’ with the Main Universe (Chaos Void), which would autonomously develop spatial layers.

Certain ancient Tenth Rank lives had an inner world with spatial layer counts that could reach hundreds of millions or even billions of layers.

In such cases, some Ninth Rank powerhouses intentionally developed more spatial layers to receive more of the universe’s Origin infusion.

A normal Ninth Rank powerhouse transcending to the Tenth Rank would tear open a gap millions of miles wide for the universe’s Origin infusion.

Whereas special Ninth Ranks that had developed tens of millions of spatial layers would tear a two to three million-mile gap upon ascending to the Tenth Rank.

Given that the time spent in breakthrough remained at 333 seconds, the difference in the amount of Main Universe Origin infusion received by the two was like night and day.

This is the greatest benefit of developing more spatial layers at the Ninth Rank.

Lin Yuan had developed more than 23 billion layers in his spatial realms.

The direct size of his inner world also exceeded two hundred million miles.

Combining various factors, the gap torn in the universe reached twelve light-years.

The resulting infusion of Chaos Void Origin was immeasurable, allowing Lin Yuan’s strength to increase far beyond expectations.

“My current true combat power is roughly equivalent to three to five Black Star Lords,” Lin Yuan gauged his own strength and made an objective assessment.

The Black Star Lord was a veteran Grade A Tier 10, having understood two Pillar-level Fusion Rules.

Although Lin Yuan had yet to comprehend one such Pillar-level rule, the power he wielded was too formidable. If the Black Star Lord indeed faced Lin Yuan,

the outcome would be—

The Black Star Lord’s full-force attack wouldn’t break through Lin Yuan’s defense.

And a casual strike from Lin Yuan, if it even grazed or brushed against him, would leave the Black Star Lord spitting blood from serious injuries.

“Elemental Body…”

Lin Yuan thought of this Physical Body Divine Ability from the World of Gods.

The combat among Tenth Rank powerhouses mainly depended on the strength of their Fusion Rules.

And Fusion Rules are also rules, simply a perfect counter for the Elemental Body.

…

After getting somewhat accustomed to the changes in himself,

Lin Yuan moved his thoughts, and his two Primordial Spirits appeared in front of him.

During the period of Chaos Void Origin infusion, the two Primordial Spirits also benefited and gained strength almost as much as the main body.

“You go to the Large Alien Battlefield.”

Lin Yuan looked towards the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

Having stepped into the Tenth Rank, Lin Yuan naturally planned to visit the Large Alien Battlefield.

Putting other things aside, at the very least, the speed of accumulating World-Breaking Origin Force there would be much faster than at Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefields.

“`

After breaking through to the Tenth Rank, the last bit of threat from the large alien battlefields to Lin Yuan gradually disappeared; as long as the supreme beings of different species didn’t take action against him, he had nothing to fear.

…

Time slipped away.

In the blink of an eye, five years had passed.

Under the operation of the ultimate beings like Xia Qin Supreme Being and others, the news of Lin Yuan’s breakthrough to the Tenth Rank finally began to go public.

Actually, if it were not made public soon, the outside world would also speculate whether the Galactic Star Lord had stepped into the Tenth Rank. With the strength Lin Yuan showed in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, breaking through to the Tenth Rank should not be difficult for him.

“Tenth Rank, did Lin Yuan really step into the Tenth Rank?”

“Two hundred years, a Tenth Rank Evolver in less than two hundred years.”

“Our Canglan Star, has actually given birth to an existence like Lin Yuan.”

After years of development, Canglan Star was already not much inferior to the main stars of some star systems, but still celebrated wildly upon learning that Lin Yuan had become a Tenth Rank Evolver.

Many young citizens of Canglan Star had no idea what it meant to be a Tenth Rank Evolver, but the fact that their own planet had produced such a great person was exhilarating to them.

…

In the virtual world.

Lin Yuan was chatting leisurely with the Black Star Lord, the Lustrous Star Master, and several other Grade A Tier 10 beings.

“Galactic Star Lord, when you broke through to the Tenth Rank and experienced the infusion of the Origin Source of the universe, how did it feel?” The Black Star Lord couldn’t help but ask.

This was also the biggest difference from the previous breakthroughs.

Tenth Rank Evolvers had already set one foot at the peak beneath the Supreme Beings.

They could receive the gifts of the Origin from the Main Universe.

This was an unprecedented great opportunity, and even for the most amazing Evolvers, they would experience it at most two or three times in their lifetime.

“Not bad,” Lin Yuan said with a smile.

Although it had been five years since he had entered the Tenth Rank, the sensation of the Chaos Void Origin Infusion still made Lin Yuan quite addicted.

The feeling that everything about oneself was crazily improving under the Origin infusion was highly addictive.

“Hahahaha.”

A smile appeared on the Black Star Lord’s face.

The Lustrous Star Master beside him also wore a smile.

If the Galactic Star Lord, who had not yet entered the Tenth Rank, was something they only valued for his potential, now the Galactic Star Lord had broken through to the Tenth Rank and stood at the same height as them.

With the talent and aptitude of the Galactic Star Lord, reaching Grade A was only a matter of time.

The major powers in the outside world estimated that in at most a few thousand years, human civilization would have another Grade A Tier 10 being.

What the Black Star Lord and the Lustrous Star Master didn’t know was that Lin Yuan’s current strength had already surpassed Tier 10 Grade A, and in a few thousand years? Lin Yuan would probably have already stepped into Tier 11.

…

In the Ziyun Star Domain.

The Great Peak Master of the Red Kun Lineage sat in the grand hall, with numerous pieces of information flickering across the light screen in front of him, mostly about the Galactic Star Lord stepping into the Tenth Rank.

“Little junior brother has become Tenth Rank,” the Great Peak Master touched his nose and shook his head, “I remember back then, I stepped into the Eighth Rank just before my junior brother did.”

“Now, I’m still struggling in the early Eighth Rank, and my junior brother has already reached the Tenth Rank?”

The Great Senior Brother felt a suffocating sensation.

The little guy who needed his protection to even break through to the Sixth Rank, had now grown to become a pillar of human civilization that would continue to grow into the future?

“Thank goodness I got along well with my junior brother back then,” a smile spread across the Great Senior Brother’s face.

After stepping into the Eighth Rank, he was in charge of a Star Domain, and the surrounding Star Lords were all trying to befriend him, banking on the face of the Galactic Star Lord, of course.

…

In the Wanyang Star Domain.

Wanyang Holy Son looked at the message in front of him, his mentality had completely changed.

“Thirteen Peak Master has become Tenth Rank…” Wanyang Holy Son rubbed his forehead, the Thirteen Peak Master whom he once regarded as his goal, had now grown to be a giant that even his own teacher had to look up to?

No, that’s not right.

Wanyang Star Lord was but an invincible Eighth Rank, facing a Tenth Rank Evolver, he couldn’t look up to him even if he wanted to.

“But… no matter how monstrous Thirteen Peak Master is, what can he do about it? Didn’t he lose to me once in the arena match…” Wanyang Holy Son thought cheerfully.

Just this incident alone would give him, Wanyang Holy Son, bragging rights for the second half of his life, and even the Wanyang Star Lord could only watch enviously.

…

Time flew by.

Another two years passed in a blink.

Chikun Star Domain, Chikun Main Star.

A majestic spatial fluctuation began to permeate, and a gigantic Starry Sky Wanderer Kun slowly wandered among the various spatial layers outside the main star.

The next moment.

This Starry Sky Wanderer Kun rapidly shrank, transforming into an old man wearing a red robe.

“Ninth Rank, this is the Ninth Rank!!”

The Chikun Star Lord cried tears of joy, overwhelmed with excitement, silently feeling the power from the many spatial layers.

After more than a hundred years of seclusion, he finally took that step and entered the Ninth Rank.

“Thirty thousand years, and I, Chikun, have also stepped into the Ninth Rank.”

The Chikun Star Lord wept, and with the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun’s affinity with space, he had just stepped into the Ninth Rank and had already opened nearly a thousand spatial layers.

“Now, in front of my disciple… I can finally hold my head up.”

The Chikun Star Lord restrained his aura. After Lin Yuan entered the Ninth Rank, his teacher had remained at the Eighth Rank.

This had put a lot of pressure on the Chikun Star Lord; although human civilization was no stranger to disciples surpassing their masters, the Chikun Star Lord also cared about his dignity.

Now that the Chikun Star Lord had stepped into the Ninth Rank, he felt a bit more confident.

Thinking this, the Chikun Star Lord began to connect to the virtual world, intending to announce his successful breakthrough and to catch up on what had happened in human civilization during his hundred years of seclusion.

However, he felt somewhat bewildered upon getting updated; not understanding was one thing, but understanding left the Chikun Star Lord somewhat astonished.

“Hm?”
